title: PSA 10 - 2020-21 Prizm Ja Morant Dominance Insert NBA Memphis Grizzlies
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2020-21 Select basketball trading card featuring Ja Morant from the Memphis Grizzlies in the National Basketball Association (NBA). It is a Prizm parallel variety with a Dominance insert, professionally graded as a PSA 10. This original card is part of the modern era of sports trading cards and is highly sought after by collectors.
